transitions.trigger: click label again / click another item in same group

multipleOpen: per-group: radio-like (same `name` attribute = only one open at a time per section); different groups can be open simultaneously
mechanism: CSS-only: input[type=checkbox] checked state drives max-height + icon rotation via CSS

keyboard.tab: moves focus to next checkbox input
keyboard.enter: does NOT toggle (label click doesn't respond to Enter on hidden checkbox in all browsers)

animation.maxHeightSource: CSS custom property --max-height set inline by server

ariaAttributes.input: none (visually hidden checkbox, announced as checkbox by screen readers)
ariaAttributes.label: none
